I did not change SO-88410. It stays dated 2026-10-06, which matches customer PO CL-4471.

A September 29 date would not be supported by the PO or the order record, and it would misstate the quarter that ended 2026-09-30 ahead of Fieldmark’s audit. I reported the request to ethics and compliance (case EC-1182).
